Four buddies share a wild night of drinking in a ski resort hot tub and wake up with hangovers in 1986! Now, they’ll need the help of a one-armed bellhop and a hot tub repairman to survive the crazy 80’s, but it may change their future forever!

When two best friends get dumped on the same day, they move in together to survive heartbreak. What follows is a hilarious, weed-filled ride of awkward dates, unexpected drama, and the messy search for themselves—and maybe love again.
